description: Hosted card top-up: freshly sign the same fund block for every poll; no commitment or payment credential is attached. expires_at is a Unix timestamp in seconds. credit_id is derived from the caller and fund_id unless the signed body names an existing caller-owned credit.

body.message: This Checkout top-up has expired; no credit can be booked.

checkout_expired.dispute_lost_hint: The card dispute was lost; no additional refund is due. Start a new top-up with a new fund_id.
checkout_expired.refunded_hint: What was still owed on the charge was refunded to the card. Start a new top-up with a new fund_id.

fund_id: Caller-generated random id, at most 200 characters; reuse the exact id for every poll.
stripe_binding: Both the Checkout Session and PaymentIntent carry all five metadata fields. The idempotency key binds dvmkit_dvm_id, dvmkit_checkout_store and fund_id. No session is adopted through account-wide lookup.
